```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
urodzenia <- read_xls(path = "dane/pl_uro_2005_00_7.xls", 
                       sheet = "Ogółem",
                       range = "C11:N41",
                       col_names = paste0("m_", 1:12),
                       na = "-") %>% 
  mutate(dzien = 1:31) %>% 
  select(dzien, everything()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("m"), 
               names_to = "miesiac",
               names_pattern = "m_(.+)",
               values_to = "ile") %>% 
  drop_na(ile) %>% 
  mutate(miesiac = month(as.integer(miesiac), label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
         data = dmy(paste(dzien, miesiac, "2005")),
         dzien_tyg = wday(data, week_start = 1, label = TRUE),
         dzien_tyg = fct_relabel(dzien_tyg, \(x) str_remove(x, "\\\\.")),
         miesiac_tydz = ceiling((wday(floor_date(data, unit = "month"), week_start = 1) + dzien - 1) / 7)) %>%
  arrange(miesiac, dzien)

urodzenia
```

```{r}
moja_data <- dmy(c("20.11.2026", "02.11.2016"))
ceiling((wday(floor_date(moja_data, unit = "month"), week_start = 1) + day(moja_data) - 1) / 7)
```

```{r}
dni_wolne_2005 <- dmy(c(
  "01-01-2005", # Nowy Rok
  "27-03-2005", # Wielkanoc
  "28-03-2005", # Poniedziałek Wielkanocny
  "01-05-2005", # Święto Pracy
  "03-05-2005", # Święto Narodowe Trzeciego Maja
  "15-05-2005", # Zesłanie Ducha Świętego (Zielone Świątki)
  "26-05-2005", # Boże Ciało
  "15-08-2005", # Wniebowzięcie Najświętszej Maryi Panny
  "01-11-2005", # Wszystkich Świętych
  "11-11-2005", # Narodowe Święto Niepodległości
  "25-12-2005", # Pierwszy dzień Bożego Narodzenia
  "26-12-2005"  # Drugi dzień Bożego Narodzenia
))
```

```{r}
naglowki_dni <- urodzenia %>% 
  distinct(miesiac, dzien_tyg) %>% 
  mutate(miesiac_tydz = 0)

p <- urodzenia %>% 
  ggplot(aes(dzien_tyg, miesiac_tydz)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = ile), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_tile(data = urodzenia %>% filter(dzien_tyg == "Sun" | data %in% dni_wolne_2005), colour = "darkred", fill = "transparent", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = dzien), size = 3, colour = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = naglowki_dni, aes(label = dzien_tyg), size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = urodzenia %>% filter(ile == max(urodzenia$ile)), aes(label = ile), colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 2.3, hjust = 0.1, vjust = 2) +
  geom_text(data = urodzenia %>% filter(ile == min(urodzenia$ile)), aes(label = ile), colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 2.3, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~miesiac, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_fill_gradient2("",
                       low = "skyblue",
                       mid = "wheat",
                       high = "tomato",
                       midpoint = 1050) +
  labs(title = "Narodziny w 2005", x = "", y = "", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.539, 1.052),
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 18, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.38),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(filename = "urodzenia.png", plot = p, path = "wykresy/", units = "cm", width = 29.7, height = 21, dpi = 300)
p
```
